Name: Tortilla mask (FS)
Author: VoidWitchCult
Description:
[center][img]https://i.postimg.cc/zD09S1Rm/title2-1-mod-details.png[/img]
﻿
Ever thought about how it felt like to wear a tortilla? You have the mighty urge to get closer to the tortilla goodness? Look no further! With this mood you can now wear the tortilla on your face and become one with it.

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/L65Gx0zJ/title2-1-installation.png[/img]
﻿
 - Install the latest version of SMAPI and Fashion Sense.
- Unzip the mod folder into Stardew Valley/Mods.
- Run the game using SMAPI.

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/FzBk4Tg2/title2-1-campatibility.png[/img]
Is not compatible with those who are allergic to tortillas or any of its ingredients.

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/3NSVKgHr/title2-1-see-also.png[/img]
